# Wood & Ramiah, LLC

> A law office serving Southern Maryland. Real estate settlements, estate planning and probate from 23087 Three Notch Road, California, Maryland 20619. Professional, competent, and caring legal services.

## Attorneys

- Joann M. Wood, Partner. Practicing in Southern Maryland since 1994, primarily real estate settlements and estate planning. Lifelong St. Mary's County resident, Leonardtown High School. Salisbury University, BA summa cum laude 1991. Georgetown University Law Center, JD 1994. Admitted in Maryland (1994), US District Court for Maryland (1995), Fourth Circuit (1999), Supreme Court of the United States (2005).
- K. Hadley Ramiah, Partner. Practicing in Southern Maryland since 2020, primarily real estate settlements, estate planning and probate. With the office since June 2020, partner since January 2026. Auburn University, BA History. LSU Law. Admitted in Louisiana (2004), Texas (2008), Maryland (2020).

The firm was formed in January 2026 when Hadley Ramiah joined Joann Wood as a partner. Before that it was The Law Office of Joann M. Wood, LLC (founded 2012).

## Services

- Residential real estate: drafting a for sale by owner contract, reviewing your real estate contract, reviewing your title abstract, deed preparation, and conducting your settlement. Purchases and refinances.
- Commercial real estate: contract drafting, title review and settlement for commercial buyers and sellers.
- Estate planning: wills (including naming a guardian for a minor child), revocable living trusts (funded to avoid probate), general power of attorney, health care power of attorney, tax planning, and trusts for minor beneficiaries or beneficiaries with special needs.
- Probate and estate administration.
- Free community seminars: Estate Planning Basics at Cedar Point Federal Credit Union (main branch training room). Registration is through the credit union.

Title insurance is written through Old Republic Title by the office's licensed Maryland title producer. The office is a Secure Insight Registered Closing Agent and uses the Qualia client portal for buyers and sellers.

## Area served

St. Mary's County, Maryland, including California, Lexington Park, Leonardtown, Hollywood, Great Mills and Mechanicsville, plus Calvert County and Charles County.

## Notice

Information on the website is general information, not legal advice. Communicating through the website does not create an attorney/client relationship. Do not send confidential information in a website or email inquiry.
